title: Foldable Solar Panel 100 W with USB-C, USB-A and DC Output
description:
A folding solar panel for camping, festivals and garden sheds that charges phones directly or feeds a power station.
• 100 W monocrystalline cells with up to 23% efficiency
• Outputs: USB-C (45 W), USB-A (18 W) and DC (18 V) for power stations
• Folds into a 4.5 kg briefcase with a carry handle
• Kickstands and corner eyelets to set it up on the ground or tie it down

title: Foldable Solar Panel 200 W for Portable Power Stations
description:
A larger folding panel that recharges a mid-size power station in an afternoon of sun.
• 200 W monocrystalline cells with an ETFE coating that resists scratches
• MC4 output plus adapters for the most common power station inputs
• IP67 junction box; splash-proof for camping in changing weather
• Folds to 60 × 53 cm and weighs 8 kg

title: Flexible Solar Panel 100 W for Campers, Boats and Curved Roofs
description:
A thin, light panel that bends to fit the curved roof of a camper van, boat or caravan.
• Bends up to 240° and is only 2.5 mm thick
• 100 W monocrystalline cells; 2.2 kg
• Pre-drilled eyelets; can also be glued with a suitable adhesive
• 1 m cable with MC4 connectors

title: Balcony Solar Kit 800 W with 2 Panels and Micro-Inverter
description:
A plug-in solar system for a balcony, terrace or garden that feeds power straight into your home's sockets.
• Two 400 W glass-glass panels and an 800 VA micro-inverter with Wi-Fi app
• Connects to an outdoor socket with the included 5 m cable
• The app shows what you produce each day, month and year
• Rules differ by country: in Germany, register the system in the Marktstammdatenregister. Check your local rules and landlord before installing

title: Portable Power Station 300 W, 288 Wh, with AC, USB-C and Car Outlets
description:
A compact battery with sockets for camping trips, garden work and short power cuts at home.
• 288 Wh capacity; 300 W pure sine wave AC socket (600 W peak)
• 60 W USB-C, 2 USB-A and a 12 V car outlet
• Recharge from a wall socket, car or a solar panel up to 100 W
• 3.8 kg with a fold-down handle

title: Portable Power Station 600 W, 512 Wh LiFePO4, with Fast Charging
description:
Enough power for a weekend of camping: lights, a fridge, laptops and phones.
• 512 Wh LiFePO4 battery rated for 3,000 charge cycles
• 2 AC sockets with 600 W pure sine wave (1,200 W peak)
• Charges from 0 to 80% in about 1 hour from the wall
• Solar input up to 200 W; 6.4 kg

title: Portable Power Station 1000 W, 1024 Wh LiFePO4, with Wheels
description:
Backup power for the fridge, router and lights during a power cut, or a full off-grid weekend in a camper.
• 1,024 Wh LiFePO4 battery rated for 3,500 charge cycles
• 4 AC sockets with 1,000 W pure sine wave (2,000 W peak)
• Switches to battery in under 20 ms when the mains fails
• Solar input up to 400 W; telescopic handle and wheels

title: Solar Power Bank 20,000 mAh with LED Flashlight, IP65
description:
A rugged power bank for hiking and camping that tops itself up a little in the sun.
• 20,000 mAh: charges most phones 4 to 5 times
• USB-C in and out (18 W) plus 2 USB-A ports
• Built-in solar panel for emergency top-ups; charges fully from USB-C
• IP65 dust- and splash-proof with a bright LED torch

title: Foldable Solar Phone Charger 21 W with 2 USB Ports
description:
Hang it on your backpack or tent and charge your phone straight from the sun.
• 21 W from three foldable panels
• 2 USB-A ports with automatic restart after clouds pass
• Folds to the size of a paperback; 600 g
• Weather-resistant canvas with hanging eyelets

title: 30 W Solar Battery Charger Kit, 12 V, for Sheds, Allotments and Gates
description:
A small off-grid kit to keep a 12 V battery charged for shed lights, an electric gate or a pond pump.
• 30 W monocrystalline panel with an aluminium frame
• 10 A PWM charge controller with 2 USB ports
• Battery clamps and a 5 m cable included
• Corner brackets for a wall, roof or post (battery not included)

title: 10 W Solar Trickle Charger for 12 V Car and Boat Batteries
description:
Keeps the battery of a car, motorbike, boat or caravan topped up while it stands unused.
• 10 W panel with a built-in charge controller to prevent overcharging
• Connect with battery clamps or the 12 V socket plug, both included
• Suction cups for the windscreen or screws for a roof
• Waterproof panel with a 3 m cable

title: Pure Sine Wave Inverter 1000 W, 12 V to 230 V, with USB-C
description:
Turns a 12 V battery into household 230 V power for a camper van, boat or off-grid cabin.
• 1,000 W continuous pure sine wave output (2,000 W peak)
• 2 EU sockets, 30 W USB-C and a USB-A port
• Protection against low battery, overload, overheating and short circuits
• Battery cables and a wired remote switch included

title: MPPT Solar Charge Controller 30 A, 12/24 V, with LCD
description:
Gets more charge from your solar panels into your battery than a basic controller, especially on cloudy days.
• MPPT tracking for up to 30% more energy than PWM controllers
• Works with 12 V and 24 V systems; up to 100 V solar input
• Supports lead-acid, AGM, gel and lithium (LiFePO4) batteries
• LCD shows voltage, current and today's yield

title: PWM Solar Charge Controller 20 A with Dual USB
description:
A simple, reliable charge controller for small solar setups on sheds, allotments and campers.
• 20 A for 12 V or 24 V systems (detects automatically)
• 2 USB ports to charge phones straight from the battery
• Protection against overcharging, deep discharge and reverse polarity
• Display shows battery level and charging status

title: Adjustable Solar Panel Tilt Mount, Set of 4 Brackets
description:
Angles your panels towards the sun on a flat roof, terrace or garden for a better yield.
• Tilt adjustable from 15° to 30°
• Anodised aluminium with stainless steel bolts; will not rust
• Fits panels up to 1,200 mm wide
• Includes all bolts and an assembly guide

title: Balcony Railing Mount for Solar Panels, Stainless Steel, Set of 2
description:
Hangs a solar panel safely on the outside of a balcony railing, without drilling into the wall.
• Fits round and square railings from 20 to 60 mm
• Adjustable tilt from 0° to 30°
• Stainless steel with rubber pads to protect the railing
• Holds one panel up to 25 kg per set

title: Solar Extension Cable 6 mm² with MC4 Connectors, Red and Black Pair
description:
Extends the cable between your solar panels and the charge controller or inverter.
• 6 mm² tinned copper for low losses over longer runs
• UV-resistant, double-insulated solar cable
• Pre-fitted MC4 connectors, IP67 when connected
• One red and one black cable in each pack

title: AA Rechargeable Batteries 2800 mAh NiMH, 8 Pack, Pre-Charged
description:
Replace hundreds of throwaway batteries in remotes, toys, game controllers and torches.
• 2,800 mAh high capacity for power-hungry devices
• Pre-charged and ready to use out of the pack
• Low self-discharge: keeps 80% of its charge after a year
• Recharge up to 500 times in any NiMH charger

title: AAA Rechargeable Batteries 1100 mAh NiMH, 8 Pack
description:
Rechargeable AAA cells for remotes, wireless mice, keyboards and small torches.
• 1,100 mAh capacity
• Pre-charged and ready to use
• Low self-discharge for devices you use only now and then
• Recharge up to 500 times in any NiMH charger

title: LiFePO4 Battery 12 V 100 Ah with Built-In BMS, for Campers and Solar
description:
A deep-cycle lithium battery for camper vans, boats and solar systems, at about half the weight of lead-acid.
• 1,280 Wh capacity; rated for over 4,000 cycles
• Built-in battery management protects against overcharge, deep discharge and short circuits
• 11 kg; can be mounted upright or on its side
• Connect up to 4 in parallel for more capacity
